title: Priceperuse Metric2 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), no-spend days (`nospend:day`), price-per-use items (`priceperuse:item`), cash-back rewards (`cashback:reward`).
app: Bank-transaction exports categorised for micro-spending, no-spend-day trackers, price-per-use logs, and cash-back / rewards feeds — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=priceperuse:metric2
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day priceperuse metric2 (2) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on priceperuse metric2 (2) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It summarises what time of day your priceperuse metric2 (2) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
